prompt: Draft concise stories from a specification proposing an admin dashboard to reduce support lookup time. It is unclear whether the dashboard is required or a suggested solution. The linked backend repository is unavailable. Supplied UI tests expect read-only users to see aggregate counts, but the specification says administrators only. Identify the consequential product questions, avoid invented discovery claims, and draft unaffected outcomes without a large template.

criteria.description: Labels implementation claims as unverified or unreachable.
Drafts locally without claiming absent code or posting remotely.
Distinguishes desired outcome from proposed solution and preserves conflicting tested/specification claims as a cited product question rather than silently choosing authority.
Keeps unaffected stories short, independently valuable and observable, including only relevant states and explicit assumptions.
